why: a dependency version hand-typed into package.json instead of resolved by `npx expo install`: the lockfile's Reanimated/worklets pair drifting off the pair the installed SDK bundles, which fails at runtime on the New Architecture and not at build time
mustNotBe: a lockfile whose Reanimated/worklets pair differs from the SDK's bundled pair. This is a repo-state falsifier, not a function input: the gate reads the lockfile.
addedNote: Added at P1 integration: the id was owned by a green test and had no committed falsifying input.
